title: Memory/Configuration Fault
shortDescription: Controller has lost its stored configuration data.
fullDescription:
Err 1 on Kinetico softeners indicates the controller's non-volatile memory has become corrupted or cleared, typically after a long power outage or after the backup battery has failed.

The head cannot execute regeneration cycles reliably until hardness, salt dose, and water-use settings are restored.

fixSteps.title: Reset controller
fixSteps.instruction: Hold the regen button for 5 seconds to clear error.

fixSteps.title: Re-enter settings
fixSteps.instruction: Input hardness, salt dose, and time of day per manual.

fixSteps.title: Replace backup battery
fixSteps.instruction: Replace CR2032 on control board if repeats.

whenToCallPro: If error returns after battery replacement, the controller board may need service.
videoSearchQuery: Kinetico water softener Err 1 memory fault

faq.a: No, regeneration is disabled until settings are restored.

title: Drive Motor Fault
shortDescription: Valve drive motor not moving as expected.
fullDescription:
Err 2 indicates the controller commanded the motor to advance the valve disk but did not detect correct rotation within the expected time.

This halts regeneration to prevent damage to the valve assembly.

fixSteps.title: Power cycle
fixSteps.instruction: Disconnect power for 60 seconds and reconnect.

fixSteps.title: Inspect gear train
fixSteps.instruction: Remove valve cover and check gears for wear or debris.

whenToCallPro: If gears are damaged or valve disk is stuck in bypass.
videoSearchQuery: Kinetico water softener Err 2 motor fix

faq.a: Yes, use the bypass valve to keep water flowing.

title: Position Sensor Fault
shortDescription: Valve position sensor not reporting correctly.
fullDescription:
Err 3 means the Hall-effect or optical position sensor that tracks valve disk rotation is not providing valid signals.

The controller cannot confirm cycle position so regeneration is halted.

fixSteps.title: Check wiring
fixSteps.instruction: Inspect sensor harness for damage or loose connector.

fixSteps.title: Clean sensor
fixSteps.instruction: Wipe optical window or Hall sensor face.

fixSteps.title: Replace sensor
fixSteps.instruction: Install new position sensor if cleaning fails.

whenToCallPro: If wiring harness requires replacement inside valve body.

title: Turbine/Flow Meter Fault
shortDescription: Flow turbine not reporting water usage.
fullDescription:
Err 4 appears when water is flowing through the softener but the turbine sensor is not sending pulses, or when the controller expects flow and sees none.

This prevents demand regeneration from triggering on schedule.

fixSteps.title: Clean turbine
fixSteps.instruction: Remove and flush turbine in vinegar.

fixSteps.title: Reseat cable
fixSteps.instruction: Push sensor connector firmly into board.

whenToCallPro: If turbine housing is cracked or leaks after cleaning.

title: Brine Valve Fault
shortDescription: Brine draw or refill cycle not completing.
fullDescription:
Err 5 indicates the brine valve is not drawing brine or refilling the tank as expected during regeneration.

This results in hard water post-regen because the resin is not being recharged.

fixSteps.title: Break salt bridge
fixSteps.instruction: Use broom handle to break up any crust in brine tank.

fixSteps.title: Clean injector
fixSteps.instruction: Remove and rinse injector nozzle and screen.

whenToCallPro: If brine valve seals need replacement.

faq.a: Solar or evaporated pellet salt; avoid rock salt.

title: Low Salt Warning
shortDescription: Salt level in brine tank is low.
fullDescription:
Err 6 is a warning that the salt in the brine tank has dropped below a usable level, or the salt sensor is reporting no contact.

Regeneration may still proceed but efficiency drops quickly.

fixSteps.title: Refill salt
fixSteps.instruction: Add pellet salt to tank up to two-thirds full.

fixSteps.title: Reset low-salt alarm
fixSteps.instruction: Press reset/regen button to clear warning.

faq.a: Fill to about 4 inches below the top of the brine tank.

title: Valve Stall
shortDescription: Valve disk failed to reach next position.
fullDescription:
Err 7 indicates the valve stalled between positions, often because of high back pressure or a damaged valve disk.

The controller retries before aborting and posting this fault.

fixSteps.title: Manual advance
fixSteps.instruction: Manually advance valve to home position per manual.

whenToCallPro: If valve disk is damaged or water leaks from head.

faq.a: Yes if incoming pressure exceeds 100 psi.

title: Regen Timeout
shortDescription: Regeneration cycle exceeded maximum allowed time.
fullDescription:
Err 8 means one step of the regeneration cycle (usually brine draw or backwash) ran past its timeout, suggesting low flow or a blockage.

The controller terminates the cycle to protect the equipment.

fixSteps.title: Check drain line
fixSteps.instruction: Ensure drain line is not kinked or frozen.

fixSteps.title: Verify pressure
fixSteps.instruction: Confirm feed pressure 30 psi minimum during regen.

whenToCallPro: If injector or drain flow control is damaged.

faq.a: Yes after clearing the cause, press regen to retry.

title: Internal Controller Fault
fullDescription:
Err 9 is raised when the on-board self-diagnostic detects a fault with the microcontroller, power supply, or firmware.

The unit will generally halt until the condition clears or a replacement board is installed.

fixSteps.title: Power cycle
fixSteps.instruction: Disconnect unit for 5 minutes then reconnect.

fixSteps.title: Call service
fixSteps.instruction: If code persists, arrange board replacement.

whenToCallPro: Almost always — requires authorized Kinetico dealer.

faq.a: Board failures are typically covered in the first 5 years.

title: Scheduled Service Reminder
shortDescription: Softener is due for routine service.
fullDescription:
The SERVICE indicator on Kinetico heads illuminates after a preset number of gallons or years of service have elapsed, signaling bed inspection, resin check, and valve lubrication.

It is informational, not a fault.

fixSteps.title: Schedule service
fixSteps.instruction: Contact dealer to inspect resin and seals.

fixSteps.title: Reset reminder
fixSteps.instruction: After service, hold regen button 10s to reset.

faq.a: You can, but routine service extends resin life.
